CI: every portable placement wiring test finds the placement step by its script

CI: key the promote gates' staging run cache by its content, not the run
CI: portable placement wiring tests find the placement step by its script
CI: the runner census reader takes large groups as per-label-set tallies
Red: the runner census cannot carry the 3,676-runner Linux group

feat(cmux-next): show favicons in native New Tab suggestions (#48417)
fix(measure): perf-idle-ab prints a footprint line only for footprints a sample measured
fix(ci): the portable placement test expects the PR control label on a first attempt (#48405)
ci: draft PR heads run a cheap tier; full CI when marked ready (#48920)
What's New: computer-use-cursor-stays gets its before, the cursor gone between actions (#48908)
Calendar widget: a cmux.widget/1 store app in the style of Apple's Calendar Up Next (#47735)
What's New clips: the tour records as the user on the display, not the last Screen Sharing login (#48905)
base red follow-up: drop the duplicate NSButton hitTest selector key (#48863)
Previews: words, not Markdown, in the daemon's rows, the Chief's push, the phone's quote; pictures in the Mac bubble
Previews: red tests for Markdown in the daemon's rows, the Chief's push, the phone's quote and the bubble's pictures
Hub: report each online Mac's quietMs so the phone knows it is awake (#48736)
ci: Swift packages on Linux becomes a pr-router callee: a Packages/macOS-only change starts none of its legs (#48757)
chore(next): base autofix at ad4bb4772366
customize-demo looks: Claude and Codex turn on their sidebar features (#48897)
cmux-rd: --help prints usage; a command left out of this build says so (#48873)
action catalog: sync Ask Chief About This… and add the env secrets playground re-pin marker (base autofix swift_parity red) (#48695)
release notes: a span cut short by a shallow fetch never ships every highlight ever written (#48883)
cmux-next push: leave the Swift canary to the scheduled tip Swift suite (#48932)
acpmux: a message follows a moved chat, and session move --after-turn moves without stopping the turn (#48432)
fix(cmux-next): generated settings Swift matches its source again: tip card and Search button off
Model picker and subagent tray: lower stale shift rows to measured values (#48871)
base red: KeychainNoPromptContext passes the namespace-type lint (#48911)
Control contrast baseline: drop the header tools, context ring and picker icon lines the fixes cleared
Agent pane: the disabled context ring draws its whole track in the tier ink, the secondary one over art
fix(ci): the Screen Sharing helper's cache key names cmux-file-lock; the Xcode phase needs only what macOS compiles
fix(ci): list the 19 SwiftUI files already on feat-cmux-next (No new SwiftUI base red)
fix(ci): the same-tree status reporter test accepts the !cancelled() guard of #48396
Native control contrast baseline: drop 13 fixed lines, raise the rest to their clean readings
Dialog buttons outside a card fit their inks to the window, see-through or not
Native contrast audit: read raw sRGB samples when the capture's tag shifts the swatch
Dialog buttons and Sign In dim in their colors when disabled, held at 3:1
Themed buttons and pop-up draw their titles in the theme's ink, also disabled
Native contrast audit: read the capture as sRGB when its tag shifts the swatch
ci(cmux-next): re-land a PR head's control hops on the reserved PR control label (#48405)
ci(cmux-tui): a re-run build leg rereads the pool instead of a stale 2 vCPU label (#48691)
ci: a PR that adds a namespace type fails the iOS conventions lint (#48901)
cmux-vm: upstream-timing test allows 5 ms timer slack (#48893)
cmux-tui artifacts retry: do not rerun a build leg that failed on a rerun (#48641)
ci: the status comment's ran line says which workflows a diff started, and why (#47361)
measure: perf-idle-ab relaunch= measures a returning user's launch (a restored workspace, not Home) (#48788)
ci: post-merge batch tier: suites once per window, bisect, revert PR (#48662)
Give Return its own read after a paste, so composer sends submit (#48753)
fix(home): Meet Chief shows on a normal fresh install; tours on a fresh profile
acpmux, Computer Use: halve the MCP server instructions every chat loads (#48667)
iOS: opening a terminal connects its Mac; offline only after a real failure (#48728)
docs(ios): cmux-next-ios-sim.sh modes list and #45397 status, verified 2026-11-21 (#48898)
Show distinct GitHub link states and refused-link reasons (#48884)
examples: customization gallery index, five starter looks (one per API surface), looks/README (#48760)
fix(ios): Feed "You" caption, white bubbles after app switch, late code scroll, swipe-back jump (#47101)
cmux NEXT: one Text Size for the sidebar, tabs, menus and chat, first in Settings and in Set Up cmux
cmux NEXT: red tests for one Text Size (Settings General card, Set Up card row, native menus)
Sidebar owner note: the hover pin draws solid at default sizes (dense icon rule); tooltip names Pin or Unpin
fix(crash): MessagesLabHome's swipe player and swipe trail convert through CrashGuard
fix(ci): four checks-job reds on feat-cmux-next (run 44876999006)
cmux-tui: cmux tmux attach renders one tmux pane through control mode (experiment, off by default) (#48633)
fix(chat): a pick's number badge reads in dark mode; the picker tour runs on a fresh app
